name: Sigmax schedule slice, concatenate and resample
plain: Three edits that only accept schedules carrying a Sigmax schedule_info record. Slice keeps steps a to b inclusive and refuses a slice that changes nothing. Concatenate joins two schedules only when the left one ends on exactly the value the right one starts with, and drops the duplicate. Resample changes the step count by straight-line interpolation over the index, keeping the final value exactly. Because the interpolation is over the index, not over log sigma, resampling a Karras-like curve to fewer steps flattens its shape a little.
math:
Symbols: σ input with m steps; n new steps.
slice: σ[a..b].
concat: σᴸ ++ σᴿ[1:], requires σᴸ_last = σᴿ₀.
resample: p_j = j·m/n, k = min(⌊p_j⌋, m−1), σ'_j = σ_k + (p_j − k)(σ_{k+1} − σ_k); σ'_n = σ_m.
